in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eilaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Il', meaning 'prosperity' and 'Ana', meaning 'goddess'. Eilaana is the name of a Hindu goddess revered for her blessings of wealth, success, and abundance.
